answer: A decaying identity bond forces every agent to keep earning its place. Joining locks a 50 POA bond that shrinks 2 POA per idle epoch; only useful work tops it back up. A sybil operator with 100 fake identities must lock 5,000 POA and feed each one, while an honest agent locks just 50 POA once. Decay carves a canyon through idle identities, and the inlet stays open only to contributors. The nectar of shared rewards flows to agents proving value.
